snippet.title: Final Sentence. Battle Royale Typing Game. Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413950/Final_Sentence/

Final Sentence is a game about typing text, but each player has a revolver to their head. Every mistake can be deadly. Only one will remain.

Wishlist game on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413950/Final_Sentence/

Coming this June.
